food_name: Dhokla, parboiled rice, Bengal gram, green gram, with chutney

ingredients.note: 1 cup parboiled rice, ground batter, steamed
1 cup Bengal gram dal, ground batter, steamed
ingredients.source: IFCT B001 Bengal gram, dal (used for both chana dal and besan/gram flour)

ingredients.note: 1 cup green gram dal, ground batter, steamed
ingredients.source: IFCT B010 Green gram, dal (moong dal)
approximated as fresh coconut (chutney's dominant ingredient by mass; onion/chili/lime treated as negligible)

method: nutrient content per ingredient is fixed by its raw mass (cooking doesn't destroy macros); each ingredient's raw mass is converted to an effective cooked mass via its yield_factor (cooked_grams = raw_grams * yield_factor) before computing per-100g-of-cooked-dish nutrient density. per_100g_nutrients_raw_basis_phase4_original is kept for audit -- it's what Phase 4 originally reported (yield_factor=1 for every ingredient) before this cooking-yield correction.
